review.notes: Full structure check (no code fences; heading set matches printed sections) plus word-level diff of all OCR lines against extracted text from all 17 physical PDF pages. All words missing from the OCR text are figure-internal architecture labels and video-grid captions (Fig. 1-3, 6-8) shown by the embedded images. Physical page 11 was rendered at 300 dpi to verify Tables 1-3 side by side (all values in the two surviving tables match the OCR exactly) and physical page 14 to verify the hyphenated compounds 'long-range' and 'inter-dancer'. The printed PDF itself ends the Fig. 8 caption with 'random seed..', so the double period is not an OCR defect. Equation (3) uses spaced OCR math (e.g. 'c _ {r e f}') which math rendering collapses, so no patch is needed.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.11 shows Tables 2 and 3 side by side, each with its own caption ('Table 2: Video quality metrics comparing different models.' / 'Table 3: Prompt alignment metrics comparing different models.'). OCR merged the two captions into one line; the patch only splits them.

OCR dropped the entire Table 3 body even though the text on OCR physical p.10 says 'The details are illustrated in Table 3.' Rendered physical p.11 (300 dpi) shows Table 3 with columns Style Capture / Creative Interpretation / Overall Satisfaction / Average and rows MusicInfuser [9]: 5.03, 7.48, 7.33, 6.61 and Wan-Dancer(Ours): 9.14, 8.73, 9.21, 9.03 (visually verified). The patch appends the table in the same HTML format as the surviving Tables 1-2, directly after Table 2 as printed; 'MusicInfuser [9]' reuses the plain-text citation form already inside the surviving tables and the 7.46 anchor cell is unique in the document.

The conclusion on rendered physical p.14 breaks the printed compound across a line as 'long-' + 'range coherence and detail preservation during rapid movements'; the abstract on physical p.1 prints 'long-range coherence' unsplit. OCR glued the hyphenation into 'longrange'.

Rendered physical p.14 (300 dpi) prints 'model inter-dancer interactions for synchronized group choreography' with the compound hyphenated across a line break ('inter-' + 'dancer'); related work on physical p.3 prints 'inter-dancer spatial interactions' unsplit. OCR glued the hyphenation into 'interdancer'.

unresolved.evidence: Text that exists only inside figure artwork (architecture labels such as 'Patchify', 'VAE Decoder', 'Unpatchify' in Fig. 1-2; per-panel video captions such as 'A dancer is performing a K-Pop dance.' in Fig. 3 and the Fig. 6-8 grids) remains interleaved as plain text around the embedded figures; the embedded images already show this content, so no text patch is proposed.
